critical_code_review_comments: routes/sheets_anagrafiche.py: preview endpoint wraps every exception with 'Errore lettura foglio: ...' prefix — this masks the specific 'Google Sheets non connesso' message that the service raises. It still returns 400 (correct HTTP code) but the user-facing detail becomes 'Errore lettura foglio: Google Sheets non connesso' instead of a clean 'Google Sheets non connesso'. Consider re-raising HTTPException from service or matching on the message and returning it as-is.

routes/sheets_anagrafiche.py oauth_callback: silently swallows exceptions in flow.fetch_token and setup_import_sheet — good UX (redirect to error page) but no server-side logging. Add logger.exception() to help debugging future OAuth issues.

routes/sheets_anagrafiche.py line 62: GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI env split('/api/') can produce empty string frontend if var missing; would build broken redirect '/integrations?sheets=error'. Add explicit fallback to FRONTEND_URL env or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
